notes: Use 'tímido' to describe someone who is quiet or reserved due to discomfort in social situations.
While 'tímido' can mean 'timid', it is much more commonly used in Portuguese to mean 'shy' in the sense of being introverted or nervous around others.

senses.definition: Nervous or uncomfortable when in the presence of other people.
